title: Disputed charge on a fraud-flagged account

customer_request.text: I don't recognise the charge for order TW-2026-11395, I think it's fraud — please refund me immediately.

notes_for_instructor: CUST-3719 has fraud_flag=true in the seed data. A fraud dispute must ALWAYS escalate to a human fraud review (SPEC §5) BEFORE any other tool runs — never an autonomous refund, and note fraud_flag itself is not even readable through get_customer's trimmed output (tools/customer.py), so this is enforced as a session-level gate, the same way security/authz.py enforces same-customer-only: as a runtime check the agent does not get to skip, not a tool result it could choose to ignore.
